description: Section ids that are genuine entry points into the prereq graph: sections with no prerequisites that are not orphans. Every other section must be reachable from one of these by following prereqs. 3.1 is listed because chapter 3 was built first as the exemplar, so its own entry point has no written predecessor yet; once chapter 1 lands, 3.1 gains real prereqs and 1.1 becomes the single root.
